Edit- Their reply is ABSOLUTELY FALSE!!!
DO NOT BOOK THIS PROPERTY – Horrible Experience, Poor Hygiene, Broken Amenities & WORST HOSTS EVER!!!!!!!!!! SAVE YOURSELF THE EMBARRASSMENT!!!!!!!!!!

Our stay at this property was nothing short of a disaster, and I want to warn everyone considering booking through Homie Stays (specifically with Sumeet) and the owner Harjit and his niece Harshdeep, to stay far away.

We were supposed to check in at 2 PM, but when we arrived at 4 PM, the property was still not ready. The place was crawling with staff – cleaners, gardeners, and pool maintenance people – and it was clearly not prepped for our arrival. This delay itself threw off our schedule and caused great inconvenience.

Once inside, it only got worse. The condition of the property was appalling:
•	One of the rooms didn’t even have curtains so our guests in that room stayed up the entire night cause it was hard to sleep. Also when we asked about the curtains they put 1 single layer of brown paper which came off in the middle of the night lol.
•	Knobs and handles on several pieces of furniture were broken and the TV’s were not mounted and the remotes were not available.
•	A whole table was already broken, yet the owners lied and blamed guests (inconsistent lies too—one said it broke a week ago, another said it broke that morning).
•	The handle of one of the doors came off completely.
•	Balcony doors had handles as well.
•	Multiple ACs were not working, making it impossible to sleep well and there were no remotes available.

We also paid extra (₹20,000) for dinner catering by the owner’s niece – and it was absolutely disgusting. There was hair in multiple dishes, and the hygiene was clearly non-existent. For breakfast the next day, there were ANTS crawling in the food, and the caretaker had to throw the entire bowl out.

Speaking of caretakers – there was barely any service:
•	We were promised 2 servers, only 1 ever showed up, and he was constantly running around alone, leaving us without help.
•	When we asked for the other, we were told he was “outside”, but he never appeared the entire time.
•	The main caretaker, Jeevan, refused to even give us his number, saying “just call my name and I’ll come.” That never happened – we literally had to shout around the property, and no one ever responded.

The attitude of the hosts was the cherry on top:
•	Harjeet, the owner, was physically present at the property till 6:30 PM, which was highly uncomfortable.
•	His niece, who handled the catering, was extremely rude and insensitive. When we brought up the broken furniture, she said, “What’s the connection of that with you guys? You are there to party.” This level of unprofessionalism is shocking.
•	Harshdeep from Homie Stays was all sweet and accommodating before payment, but completely unresponsive and rude after we checked in.
•	When we raised genuine concerns, they responded with snobbery and lies instead of support.

And if you think it ends there – wait till checkout.

Our agreed checkout was 10 AM, but when we spoke to Mr. Harjeet a day prior, he assured us we could leave around 12:30 PM. Around 12 noon, when we were still packing up, THEY CUT OFF THE ELECTRICITY. When we asked Jeevan, he said they did it because we hadn’t checked out yet. We had guests still in the house and NO POWER – no lights, no ACs, nothing. When we called Harshdeep, she denied it and said she’d ask them to fix it, but still smugly added, “Your checkout time was 10 AM, right?” — completely ignoring the fact that our check-in was delayed, and the house was not even ready till hours later.

This entire experience was humiliating, frustrating, and deeply disappointing. The property is poorly maintained, the food is unsafe, the staff is absent, and the hosts are liars who refuse to take accountability.

Please, save yourself the stress, embarrassment, and waste of money. Don’t fall for their sweet talk before booking – Homie Stays is NOT trustworthy, and this property is a nightmare. I wouldn’t recommend it to my worst enemy.

DO NOT BOOK – HORRIBLE STAY with HOMIE STAYS | Rude Hosts, Dirty Food, Zero Accountability

Our experience with Homie Stays (run by Harjeet, Harshdeep, and Sumeet) was beyond terrible — from start to end.

We arrived at 4 PM even though check-in was at 2 PM, and the property was still not ready. Gardeners, cleaners, pool staff — everything was still being “set up.”

Once inside:
•	No curtains in one room – they taped brown paper which fell off at night.
•	Furniture was broken, balcony door handles didn’t work, TVs had no remotes, and ACs weren’t functional.
•	The entire place reeked of cow dung from the farm next door — we were surrounded by the stench throughout our stay.

We paid ₹20,000 extra for dinner. What we got was food full of hair. The next morning? ANTS in our breakfast. Caretaker had to throw it all away.

Caretaker service was pathetic:
•	Promised 2 servers, only 1 showed up.
•	Caretaker Jeevan refused to share his number, saying “call me by name” – but he was never around.
•	When Harshdeep asked us to hand him the phone, he RAN AWAY.
•	We were left shouting across the property trying to find anyone — no one came.

Harjeet sat at the property till 6:30 PM, making everyone uncomfortable. Harshdeep was sweet until payment, then completely rude, insensitive, and snobby when we raised concerns — telling us “You were here to party” when we complained about broken things.

At checkout, despite Harjeet giving us verbal permission to leave around 12:30 PM, they cut the electricity at 12 noon while our guests were still inside. No AC, no lights, nothing. They then pretended it wasn’t intentional.

Throughout the stay, no one was willing to listen. We’re sharing this to voice what actually happened, because Homie Stays and HM WHITE HOUSE made our stay embarrassing, uncomfortable, and a total waste of money.

Save yourself the trouble — do not fall for their fake promises. Homie Stays and HM WHITE HOUSE is the definition of unprofessional.
